 NPL: Two Matches Scheduled for Today as Chitwan Rhinos Face Sudurpashchim Royals
 November 2, 2026 
 Chitwan, November 2: Two matches are scheduled for today in the Nepal Premier League (NPL) at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur.
 In the first match, Kathmandu Gorkhas will take on Karnali Yaks at 12:00 noon. The second match, scheduled to begin at 5:00 pm, will see Sudurpashchim Royals face Chitwan Rhinos.
 Chitwan Rhinos have remained unbeaten so far in the tournament. They won their opening match, while their second game was abandoned due to rain, resulting in both teams sharing points.
 Sudurpashchim Royals, meanwhile, have secured one victory and suffered two defeats in their three matches.
 Meanwhile, Chitwan Rhinos have arranged free transportation for their supporters travelling from Chitwan to Kathmandu to watch today’s match against Sudurpashchim Royals.
 The club has arranged five buses for fans who have already purchased match tickets. According to club director Pratap Devkota, the transportation service will operate on a first-come, first-served basis.
 He said the buses would take supporters from Chitwan to Kathmandu and bring them back after the match.
 All five buses have already been filled with supporters. They are scheduled to depart from the campus of Chitwan Medical College in Bharatpur.
